title: stabilize-quality-coverage-and-pr-body-20260730
outOfScope: Changing the 85.10% coverage threshold or disabling the pre-push quality gate.
Changing archived WI-10 records or its delivered installation documentation.
Creating a PR through shell-interpolated content.

sources.reason: Fresh pre-push quality run: 1529 tests passed but total coverage was 85.06%, below the 85.10% enforced floor.
The WI-10 documentation checker has untested fail-closed branches suitable for focused regression coverage.
Requires a separate Contract, branch lifecycle, and fail-closed verification.

riskAssessment.reason: Coverage must remain safely above the enforced floor; PR publication must not execute user-visible markdown as shell syntax.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized continuous corrective execution and the scope is bounded to tests and safe PR publication.

preReviewWarnings: Review that new tests cover existing fail-closed behavior and do not loosen coverage policy.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A fresh full `make quality` passes with total coverage materially above 85.10%, without changing the threshold.
New focused tests exercise existing documentation-metadata fail-closed branches and remain deterministic.
PR creation uses a body file or another non-shell-interpolated mechanism; no Markdown backticks are evaluated as shell commands.
The corrective Work Item completes its active Outcome, archive, PR, hosted CI, merge, and closure lifecycle before WI-10 publication resumes.
guidelines: Do not lower a quality threshold to hide an insufficient test-coverage margin.
Treat PR prose as data, never as executable shell input.

intent.problem: The WI-10 branch passed one local quality run only narrowly, then failed the enforced pre-push quality run at 85.06%. In addition, a PR body passed with shell backticks caused command substitution and an unintended quality run instead of a PR.
constraints: Add tests only; do not weaken fail-closed documentation checks.
Use a non-shell-interpolated PR body mechanism.
intent.rationale: A governed release path must be reproducibly green and must not permit presentation text to execute commands.

rawUserRequest: Continue the authorized WI-10 lifecycle; repair any release-flow and quality-gate issue rather than bypassing it.

declaredIntent.summary: Stabilize deterministic coverage and safely publish the already-archived WI-10 through its required lifecycle.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A full quality run uses a different test collection path.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Coverage stays above 85.10% without policy changes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add focused tests for previously uncovered documentation-checker error branches and run fresh make quality.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A PR description contains Markdown backticks.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The content remains literal PR prose and starts no shell command.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Create the PR using a body file passed to gh, then inspect the rendered body.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
